name: MATLAS-1907 (Hubble)
blurb: MATLAS-1907, a dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: matlas1907-hubble
story: A faint dwarf galaxy from the MATLAS survey, one of the ultra-diffuse galaxies Hubble surveyed away from crowded galaxy clusters. Hubble looked here for the globular clusters scattered around it.

claims.text: MATLAS-1907 is a dwarf elliptical galaxy
The program targeted ultra-diffuse galaxies in non-cluster environments to study their globular clusters
Hubble studied the globular cluster systems of MATLAS ultra-diffuse galaxies
